subject: Seoul & Mumbai micro-region split - capacity recommendation and deal tie-in
body:
From: Priya Menon <priya@astratech.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: HK EdgeOps <edgeops@hkedge.io>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Seoul & Mumbai micro-region split - initial ask

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We ran a quick internal sizing exercise and want to propose a tri-split pilot for our Asia footprint: primary nodes in Seoul, a smaller hot-standby in Mumbai, and edge staging in Singapore. The idea is to route low-latency inference for Korean customers to Seoul, heavier batch jobs to Mumbai overnight, and use Singapore only for intermittent bursts.

Initial asks:
- Pilot duration: 90 days
- Target sustained qps: 1200 token-gen qps (avg) for Seoul peak windows
- Mumbai burst capacity to handle 400 qps overnight + 1.5x buffer
- SLA target: 150ms p95 for Seoul regional calls

Can you provide a capacity proposal (pool sizing + recommended GPU types), an estimated monthly unit cost, and any network/peering reqs we should expect? We need this to align with procurement and our cloud partner (Acme Cloud).

Attached: a quick spreadsheet with our internal traffic split and a latency matrix.

—Priya
Priya Menon
Head of Platform
AstraTech

-----Original Message-----
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Menon <priya@astratech.ai>
Cc: PrioM Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 07:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Seoul & Mumbai micro-region split - initial ask

Priya — thanks for the details and the spreadsheet. High level thoughts below (will follow up with exact numbers and an attached workbook):

- Recommended GPU mix: Seoul production pool -> 6 x A10G equivalent (or one r4.4x equivalent cluster) for sustained low-latency workloads; deploy with 8-bit quantization profiles for chat/assistant models.
- Mumbai: 3 x A10G-equivalent nodes configured for batch/throughput with autoscaling up to 6 nodes for planned overnight peaks.
- Singapore (edge staging): keep a 1-node warm standby (A10G) with prefix cache enabled and fast cold-start fallback to Mumbai.
- Networking: need dedicated VPC peering to Acme Cloud region ap-south-1 and a direct connect / MDN edge for sub-20ms egress to Seoul ISPs for best p95. We can operate with transit but will see higher variance.
- Cost: short-form estimate ~ $65k/month (weighted) for the pilot configuration with expected unit token costs ~ 18% higher than main NA pool due to smaller scale and burst-ready nodes. Exact breakdown in the workbook.

Next steps: Hannah will map to our regional capacity calendar and identify available provisioning windows; Priyom will run a deal-prioritization check against current queued onramps to confirm we can allocate the requested pools for 90 days without impacting SLA-backed commitments.

If that sounds right I’ll circulate a formal sizing + SOW draft for your procurement team.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

On Wed, 14 Jan 2026 09:20:00 -0800, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai> wrote:
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>; Priya Menon <priya@astratech.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>; Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Subject: Seoul/Mumbai pilot - capacity dates and node lead times

Karthik/Priya,

Quick internal check on lead times and a couple of risk flags:
- Physical GPU availability: we have a limited number of r4-equivalent instances available for Feb–Mar provisioning in ap-northeast-2. If AstraTech wants a Feb start, we need final signoff by EOD Jan 19 so procurement can prioritize inventory.
- Cross-region networking: provisioning a direct connect to Acme Cloud in ap-northeast-2 takes ~18 business days after LOA. That pushes low-variance p95 improvements out unless Acme can expedite.
- Migration strategy: recommend starting with a smaller Seoul pool (4 nodes) for week 1 to validate latency and routing, then scale to 6 nodes on week 3 after traffic validation.

Irene — please advise on any additional security/compliance gating for Mumbai (ap-south-1) — we may need to toggle data-residency flags depending on AstraTech's enterprise controls.

Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Regional Capacity Planner | Redwood Inference

On Wed, 14 Jan 2026 12:05:00 -05:00, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai> wrote:
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>; Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>; Priya Menon <priya@astratech.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Subject: RE: Seoul/Mumbai pilot - capacity dates and node lead times

Thanks Hannah. Quick security notes for the Mumbai node:
- If AstraTech will store any PII-derived embeddings or audit logs in Mumbai we need them to sign our APAC data handling addendum. Without that we must isolate KV caches with regional encryption keys (customer-managed KMS preferred).
- SOC2/ISO artifacts: we can provide redacted audit logs and network diagrams; timeline to collect evidence for procurement is ~3 business days.

Priyom — can you double-check whether the deal economics here justify a priority reservation vs. best-effort allocation? If this is strategic for AstraTech (they mentioned plans to expand heavily in Korea), we should consider offering a 6-month reserved tranche with a small discount to secure capacity.

Irene
Irene Choi
Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference

On Mon, 18 Jan 2026 15:42:00 -05:00, Priya Menon <priya@astratech.ai> wrote:

Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Subject: Re: Seoul & Mumbai micro-region split - capacity recommendation and deal tie-in

Karthik / team — thanks, this is very helpful. We want to move forward with the 90-day pilot but will opt for the staged approach Hannah suggested (4 -> 6 nodes in Seoul). A few asks before procurement:
1) Please attach the final workbook with exact monthly pricing and a clear list of networking prerequisites so we can loop Acme Cloud.
2) We will sign a 90-day SOW; if performance meets p95 targets we would like the option to convert to a 6-month reserved tranche at a mutually agreed discount.
3) For Mumbai, we will restrict PII storage to a regional customer-managed KMS — Irene, your team’s APAC addendum looks good; please send it to legal for review.

If you can get the workbook and SOW draft by Jan 20 we’ll have procurement confirmation by Jan 28 and aim for a Feb 8 start.

Thanks — looking forward to this pilot.

—Priya
Priya Menon
Head of Platform, AstraTech
